changes.old: The unit code determines the measure of the duration and MUST be derived from the employee pay frequency, never hard-coded: M = months worked (full quarter 3, pay frequency monthly); J = days worked on a 30-day-month convention (full quarter 90, pay frequency daily); H = hours worked (full quarter ≈ 520, pay frequency hourly). Partial quarters are prorated on the same basis as the unit emitted. The duration feeds the insured-period record used for pension validation, so an incorrect unit may pass the file check yet still misstate entitlement.
changes.new: The unit code determines the measure of the duration. The unit is a CLIENT-LEVEL PARAMETER (guide p.36: M for monthly-paid, J for day-paid, H for hourly-paid workers; the client decides and records it). M = months worked (full quarter 3); J = DAYS worked, 0-92 per quarter (client convention, e.g. 90 per full quarter minus unpaid-absence days); H = hours worked (full quarter ≈ 520). Partial quarters are prorated on the same basis as the unit emitted. Never emit hours with unit J. The layout has no separator, so the birth date is immediately followed by the Q1 duration - this is correct. The duration feeds the insured-period record used for pension validation, so an incorrect unit may pass the file check yet still misstate entitlement.

changes.old: Normative. Unit derived from pay frequency.

changes.old: Monthly-paid worker. Durée expressed in MONTHS; full quarter = 3. Use when pay frequency is monthly (guide p.36). NOTE: the value basis is inferred — M has not been observed in an accepted file.
changes.new: Monthly-paid worker (guide p.36: travailleurs mensuels). Durée expressed in MONTHS; full quarter = 3. Selected through the client-level DAS unit parameter. NOTE: the value basis is inferred — M has not been observed in an accepted file.

changes.old: Day-paid worker. Durée expressed in DAYS on a 30-day-month convention; full quarter = 90. Use when pay frequency is daily (guide p.36). The only unit observed in an accepted file.
changes.new: Day-paid worker (guide p.36: journaliers). Durée expressed in DAYS on a 30-day-month convention; full quarter = 90. Selected through the client-level DAS unit parameter. The only unit observed in an accepted file.

changes.old: Hourly-paid worker. Durée expressed in HOURS; full quarter ≈ 520 (3 x 173.33). Use when pay frequency is hourly (guide p.36). NOTE: the value basis is inferred — H has not been observed in an accepted file.

changes.old: STATUTORY LAYER — very high. All 36 fields, both filenames, the centimes and no-separator rules, the M/J/H unit rule, the deadline and the complete p.41-42 validation catalogue are taken verbatim from the guide and confirmed against the live portal copy. EMPIRICAL LAYER (tier B) — medium. Justification and padding, line terminators, the Date Sortie blank convention and the duration basis per unit are NOT in the guide and rest on ONE accepted submission from ONE employer number, ONE filing year and ONE payroll vendor. UNVERIFIED — units M and H have never been observed in an accepted file (only J); declaration type C has never been observed; multi-cotisant filing behaviour is inferred; the duration bounds in SYN-18 are inferred from error-message names, as CNAS publishes no bounds. Treat the statutory layer as settled and the tier-B layer as provisional until corroborated across 2-3 independent customers.
